blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — In front of her PLDT teammates and coaches, Kath Arado got engaged to her longtime boyfriend Allan Joseph Moral on Wednesday. The members of the High Speed Hitters shared congratulatory messages and photos of Arado during the engagement that happened in Tagaytay. READ: PVL: Kath Arado helps PLDT win in front of family, hometown crowd “The entire team and management are just bursting with happiness for the two of you!” the High Speed Hitters official account’s post read.
